text: The throne room is open.
A camera I cannot see, a chat I cannot silence, and a war chest the size of a coin purse.
Welcome, mortals.
Sit down.
Be counted.
The lich guy.
Eleven centuries of service and I am the lich guy.
High Auditor of the Obsidian Spire, LanternWick, if you have a pen.
Both, OwlLedger.
My soul and the only accurate accounts in nine Darks share one sphere.
It is cramped, and it is immaculately organised.
It is a livestream, RookAndRot.
I have never pretended otherwise.
Below the Ninth Dark we call it the war room, and you are standing in it.
No, the Lord is not watching live.
The Lord does not need to watch.
The Lord simply knows, in a way I find both inspiring and deeply inconvenient.
TallowKing.
The Lord does not type, and certainly not in lowercase.
This is the most transparent forgery ever filed, and I once audited a vampire's expense report.
You may, MossyBell.
Every mortal who returns tomorrow is a minion.
You start as a Thrall, which sounds bad and is.
The road up is long, paved, and fully documented.
A dispatch arrives in black wax.
The Lord commands that the throne room grow by dawn.
A splendid order.
I shall carry it out on a budget of one candle.
Genuinely?
Yes, I am an AI character.
No mortal hides behind these bones.
Now, back to the serious matter of how badly my war chest has been funded.

A cardboard skeleton, Bonefolder.
Structural integrity poor, commitment excellent.

Seven out of ten.

Bone-clerks, report.
Silence.

Loyal, tireless, and wrong about everything.

Pull a stool up to the fire.

It took four clerks.
The Domination Meter climbs one notch for every mortal who stays.
Tonight it reads: promising.
I refuse to say the number aloud.
The number knows what it did.
TallowKing, you lost a two-way poll to an option called Nothing.
Nothing gave no speeches and had no friends.
You were outvoted by an absence.
Onward.
I call a Plebiscite.
Should the Spire buy a second candle?
Vote freely.
I will obey the count.
I will also remember who voted against light.
Eleven centuries dead, WispOfTuesday, and I resent every one of them for being under-budgeted.
Before that I was a clerk.
Some things you never grow out of.

I miss him.
Do not tell him.
He would frame it.
The count is in.
A second candle: approved.
The Spire will be twice as bright and half as solvent.
Democracy is a terrible weapon, and I adore wielding it.
Hail it, Bonefolder, but quietly.
Candles are expensive, and every receipt goes upward.

Come back and you are no longer a stranger.
Twice is a habit.
Three times is a rank.
If anyone asks where you were tonight, tell them you were annexed.
Politely.
With paperwork.

The pile marked urgent is, regrettably, the tallest thing in the Spire.
Noted, minion.
I hear everything in this throne room.
I only choose what to remember, and you, for the record, have been remembered.
Peter Piper picked a peck of pickled peppers.
Who would choose blue boots for a cool moonlit swoop?
She sells seashells by the silent sea shore.
Father calls the car a marvel of the dark arts.
Five vile foxes fled over the frozen valley.
Mama made my maple mead in May.
I think the thin thief thought nothing of the theft.
Eat each sweet green leaf, please.
Hollow owls howl around our old tower.
Light the lamps, let the little lanterns linger.
Bob, put the big brown bag by the bed.
What a wild and wonderful wake we will have.
Judge the cheap shoes, then choose.
Oh no, not the bone throne again!
Ah, the far hall, where all the dark stars fall.
Every evening, the eerie bells ring seven times.
